title: Read-only Business Central page context smoke test
goal: Open Business Central read-only, confirm the expected sandbox and company URL context, and collect stronger shell/page context without data changes.
safetyGates: Abort if URL does not contain MCP_1_20260210.
Abort if company URL parameter is not RM-DEMO.
Abort if a dialog with OK, Yes, Ja, Post, Preview, Delete, New or Edit appears.
Do not click global actions or unsafe buttons.
Stay on the initial Role Center or shell context if page opening would be ambiguous.
acceptanceCriteria: Business Central opens with existing storageState.
Instance MCP_1_20260210 is confirmed from URL.
Company RM-DEMO is confirmed from URL parameter.
Business Central shell/search context is visible.
Compact read-only shell/page context is captured.
Result JSON contains no-write, no-post, no-preview, no-draft and no-setup-change flags.
nextSafeAction: Run npm run fibu:live-smoke:readonly-page-context after agent:run-plan passes.
